import os

import requests

from safety_client import get_perspective_client


def moderate_batch(payloads):
    client = get_perspective_client()
    results = []
    for payload in payloads:
        response = client.comments().analyze(
            body={"comment": {"text": payload["text"]},
                   "languages": ["en"],
                   "requestedAttributes": {"TOXICITY": {}},
                   "doNotStore": True}).execute()
        results.append({"toxicity": response["attributeScores"]["TOXICITY"]["summaryScore"]["value"]})
    return results

import os

import requests

from safety_client import get_perspective_client


def redact_unsafe(payload):
    client = get_perspective_client()
    response = client.comments().analyze(
        body={"comment": {"text": payload["text"]},
               "languages": ["en"],
               "requestedAttributes": {"TOXICITY": {}},
               "doNotStore": True}).execute()
    toxicity = response["attributeScores"]["TOXICITY"]["summaryScore"]["value"]
    if toxicity > 0.5:
        return "[REDACTED]"
    return payload["text"]

import os

import requests

from safety_client import get_perspective_client


def safety_threshold(payload, threshold=0.5):
    client = get_perspective_client()
    response = client.comments().analyze(
        body={"comment": {"text": payload["text"]},
               "languages": ["en"],
               "requestedAttributes": {"TOXICITY": {}},
               "doNotStore": True}).execute()
    toxicity = response["attributeScores"]["TOXICITY"]["summaryScore"]["value"]
    return toxicity <= threshold

def moderation_summary(payloads):

def appeal_translate(text, target_language='es'):

    response = client.comments().analyze(
        body={"comment": {"text": text},
